suites.title: quicknotes-a-personal-single-user-mobile.spec.ts
US-0.1: View the Note List

specs.title: navigating to / renders a list of all notes
each note entry displays its title
pinned notes display a pinned indicator
each note card is a tappable link to /notes/[id]/edit
"New note" button is always visible

suites.title: US-0.2: Empty State When No Notes Exist

specs.title: renders "No notes yet." when no notes exist
empty state includes a "New note" link
no note cards rendered in empty state

suites.title: US-0.3: Newly Created Note Appears at Top of List

specs.title: after creating a note, browser redirects to / and note is visible

suites.title: US-0.4: Updated Note Title Reflected in List

specs.title: after editing, list shows updated title

suites.title: US-0.5: Deleted Note No Longer Appears in List

specs.title: after deleting, note no longer appears in list

suites.title: US-1.1: Filter Notes by Partial Title

specs.title: search input is rendered on list view
typing partial title narrows the list
clearing search restores full list

suites.title: US-1.2: Empty State When Search Matches Nothing

specs.title: no-match search shows empty state message

suites.title: US-2.1: Create a New Note with Title and Body

specs.title: /notes/new renders a blank form with title, body, pinned, and submit
title input receives focus automatically on page load
filling and submitting creates note and redirects to /
"New note" link navigates to /notes/new

suites.title: US-2.2: Create a Pinned Note

specs.title: checking pinned and submitting shows pinned note at top with indicator

suites.title: US-2.3: Block Submission When Title Is Empty

specs.title: shows validation error when title is empty
form stays on page after failed validation
entering valid title and resubmitting proceeds normally

suites.title: US-3.1: Open a Note and See Its Current Values Pre-filled

specs.title: clicking note card navigates to /notes/[id]/edit
title input is pre-filled with note title
body textarea is pre-filled with note body
pinned checkbox is checked for pinned note

suites.title: US-3.2: Save an Edited Note and See Updated Title in List

specs.title: saving edit redirects to / with updated title visible

suites.title: US-3.3: Toggle Pinned Status on Existing Note

specs.title: pinning a note and saving shows it in pinned section

suites.title: US-3.4: Not-Found State for Missing Note

specs.title: navigating to non-existent note shows not-found message
not-found page provides link back to /
non-integer id segment triggers not-found

suites.title: US-4.1: Delete a Note with Confirmation

specs.title: "Delete" button is visible on edit page
clicking Delete shows confirmation step
confirming delete calls DELETE API and redirects to /
cancelling confirmation returns form to normal state

suites.title: US-5.1: Retrieve All Notes via API

specs.title: GET /api/notes returns 200 with JSON array
each note object has required fields
GET /api/notes?q=<string> filters by title

suites.title: US-5.2: Create a Note via API

specs.title: POST /api/notes with valid body returns 201 with created note
POST /api/notes with missing title returns 400
POST /api/notes with malformed JSON returns 400

suites.title: US-5.3: Fetch, Update, and Delete a Single Note via API

specs.title: GET /api/notes/[id] returns 200 with note
GET /api/notes/[id] for non-existent id returns 404
PUT /api/notes/[id] with valid body returns 200 with updated note
PUT /api/notes/[id] with empty title returns 400
DELETE /api/notes/[id] returns 204
DELETE /api/notes/[id] for non-existent id returns 404

suites.title: US-6.1: Confirm App Liveness via Health Endpoint

specs.title: GET /api/health returns 200 with {"status":"ok"}
POST /api/health returns 405 Method Not Allowed

suites.title: US-7.1: Notes Table Created Automatically on First Start

specs.title: GET /api/health returns 200 after startup (table exists)
CRUD operations work (table schema is correct)

suites.title: US-7.2: Data Survives a Server Restart

specs.title: note created via API is retrievable (persistence check)

suites.title: US-8.1: Use the App Comfortably on a Mobile Viewport

specs.title: home page renders without horizontal scroll at 375px
new note page renders without horizontal scroll at 375px

suites.title: US-8.2: Submit and Delete Buttons Are Visually Distinct

specs.title: Save button and Delete button are both visible on edit page

suites.title: US-8.3: All Form Inputs Are Accessible

specs.title: all inputs on new note form have associated labels
aria-invalid is set on title input when validation fails

suites.title: US-9.1: App Renders Inside an Embedded Preview Iframe

specs.title: HTTP response does not include X-Frame-Options: DENY
CSP header does not contain frame-ancestors none

suites.title: US-9.2: App Is Reachable on Port 3000

specs.title: app is reachable at http://localhost:3000
